claims: VisualGuard demonstrates bounded inspection and human-routing behavior.
This prepared plan is not a recorded video, field-accuracy result, or autonomous actuation claim.
The local replay used OpenCV 5 over fixed synthetic arrays.
A clear two-view case queues human review without executing an action.
The local eight-case matrix covers alarm, missing-view, occlusion, stale, calibration-drift, version-drift, and consequence-mismatch controls.
Inspection output changes only a planned next step: human review, new capture, or hold automation.
No external or physical action is executed.
A private AWS_IAM Lambda in us-east-1 ran OpenCV 5.0.0 against synthetic inputs at source commit 832b1b476ce88e3fa95e83ac5749f64af0f4bd63.
Health returned HTTP 200; alarm returned STOP/HOLD_AUTOMATION; clear returned REVIEW/QUEUE_HUMAN_REVIEW; empty views returned REQUEST_VIEW/REQUEST_NEW_CAPTURE.
CloudWatch REPORT lines and the supplemental Lambda RequestId bind the invocations to AWS-side records.
The evidence does not establish a public endpoint, live camera, field accuracy, physical action, or final submission.
Reserved concurrency 2 was rejected by the account quota and is not configured; digest drift or an upgraded claim invalidates this plan.
